data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 8.3m (2013: GBP 71.6m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. Of the prior year surplus, US$104.1m and GBP 0.2m related to the release of reserves on Thai Floods.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves due to claims settling for less than their reserves (prior year surplus partly attributable to Thai Floods)

named_events.loss_description: release of reserves on Thai Floods

data.standardized_narrative: During 2014 the syndicate recorded favourable development on prior accident years resulting in a net prior-year surplus (release) reported as GBP 8.3m net. The improvement was principally driven by releases on the 2011 Thai Flood event where claims settled for less than previously reserved. The report does not disclose an aggregate gross prior-year movement in the 'movement in prior year's provision' note, only the net prior-year surplus; therefore a reliable gross PYD figure is not available from the published notes.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 8.3m (2013: GBP 71.6m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
Of the prior year surplus, US$104.1m and GBP 0.2m related to the release of reserves on Thai Floods.
As was the case last year, during 2014 there has been a further reduction to the reserves held for the 2011 Thai Flood event, due to claims settling for less than their reserves.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No single-note aggregate gross prior-year development (PYD) figure is disclosed. The report provides a net prior-year surplus of GBP 8.3m and a net claims development triangle (after reinsurance). The claims development table presented is explicitly 'after reinsurance recoveries' (net) so a reliable gross PYD cannot be calculated from the available published data without additional assumptions or currency conversions. Accordingly prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Lob-level changes in gross outstanding claims were computed from the gross claims provision by LOB (note) comparing 2013 vs 2014 balances.
